description: Revoke an invite code (or its relay id) so the relay refuses any further claim; members who already joined stay. Requires RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN. Use when a code leaked, was sent to the wrong person, or is no longer needed. Waiting for the invite to expire instead is wrong because a leaked code keeps admitting holders until then. The relay must support POST /api/invites/revoke; an older relay answers that revocation is unsupported.

code.description: The v2 invite code to revoke.

gatewayUrl.description: Compatibility assertion: must match RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL (default https://x.ruv.io). Change the server environment to select another gateway.

id.description: The invite uuid, instead of the code.

name: x_federation_invite_revoke
